title.narrative: Strengthening the Capacity of Mongolia National Audit Office

description.narrative: The purpose of the grant is to improve the effectiveness of Mongolia National Audit Office's (MNAO) financial audit process, especially in IT systems audit in order to better assess the accountability of public finances. This is in line with the development of new Government Financial Management Information System (GFMIS), which went live in January 2005. MNAO would like to obtain assistance in establishing IT system audit capacity, thereby ensuring adequate internal controls surrounding the GFMIS inputs and control environment. This is to apply the budgets for project supervisions for two years. The purpose of the grant is to improve the effectiveness of MNAO's financial audit process, especially in IT systems audit in order to better assess the accountability of public finances. This is in line with the development of new Government Financial Management Information System (GFMIS), which went live in January 2005. MNAO would like to obtain assistance in establilshing IT systems audit capacity, thereby ensuring adequate internal controls surrounding the GFMIS inputs and control environment. The following outcomes are expected: 1) reasonable assurance of the integrity of GFMIS; 2) improved effectiveness of IT auditing; and 3) assurance of appropriate control environment in the new GFMIS.
